name: ntasks
description: A task hub for people and AI agents, on Cloudflare Workers and D1.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter "@ntasks/web..." run build && pnpm --filter @ntasks/api run dev

AUTH_SECRET.description: A random value of at least 32 characters. Make one with `openssl rand -base64 32` and keep a copy: after the deploy, the setup page at `/sign-in` asks for it once to set up GitHub sign-in. It signs session cookies and sign-in state, and encrypts the stored GitHub App credentials, GitHub tokens and agents' client secrets.
